question.text: An Equity-Linked Savings Scheme (ELSS) has lock-in:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** ELSS: 3-year lock-in; Section 80C deduction up to Rs. 1.5 lakh per FY. **The Trap:** Other lock-in schemes have different horizons. **Cross-Exam Context:** V-A. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** ELSS = tax-saving + equity exposure combined — efficient for eligible clients.
